subject: C2a-3 full retained-closure admission implementation plan r1

findings.title: The public admission-failure shape is contradictory and does not define one Budget route
findings.concreteFailure: The plan publicly re-exports ComponentAdmissionFailure while its provisional Invariant variant carries CollectorFault, which the same plan requires to remain private and not leak. Separately, open_retained_tree can return TreeReadFailure::Budget, but the selected public sum also has a top-level Budget variant without an exhaustive normalization rule. Exhaustion during retained-tree open can therefore emerge under Tree and be misrouted by a later owner that selects J row 11 from the top-level Budget variant.
findings.requiredCorrection: Select one concrete non-leaking public invariant representation and keep CollectorFault private. Specify exhaustive conversions for ClosureFailure, TreeReadFailure, representation arithmetic, transfer, and collector outcomes, including WorkFailure::Budget to top-level Budget and TreeReadFailure::Budget to top-level Budget while all non-Budget tree causes remain Tree. Reconcile every plan annex and require source controls for both Budget-producing input forms and collector privacy.

evidenceLimitations: Plan review only; no arithmetic script, compiler, native code, build, test, fixture, or receipt lane was executed.
Frozen arithmetic reports show internal formula consistency only; they do not establish source completeness, native ABI/layout, allocation behavior, or implementation conformance.
Safe lifetime expressibility, exact carriers, feature and export closure, source-category guards, owner controls, and named native and receipt gates remain later evidence.
